question: At 20% cofiring, what CO2, CO and NO changes does post-flame injection give, and what NO change does burnout-zone injection give?
expect: post-flame: CO2 -33%, CO -80%, NO about +88%; burnout zone: NO about +571% (abstract)
rendered: At 20% cofiring, postflame injection minimizes CO2 and CO concentrations, corresponding to reductions of 33.0% and 80.47%, respectively. However, it increases NO by 88%. Burnout-zone injection causes a much larger NO penalty, about +571%.
